# SD18 deterministic Human Sorcerer level 20 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Sorcerer
# level-1..level-19 spontaneous spell-burden baseline
# (tests/sd18_sorcerer_level19_widening.rs) to Sorcerer level 20, the final
# level within PF1's 1-20 character-level cap, as chosen input only. It
# names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values.
# It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat posture from the
# level-1..level-19 fixtures, and the same canonical bloodline and bloodline
# class-skill selections (Arcane, Knowledge [arcana]), adding only the level
# bump this cycle needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Sorcerer burden surface: no Arcane Bond
# execution, no bloodline arcana, no bloodline power/feat selection, no
# bloodline bonus spell selection, no spellbook, no which-spells-known
# selection, and no spontaneous-casting execution. The PF1 CRB Sorcerer
# class table's level-20 "Special" column reads "Bloodline power" (verified
# independently against a raw un-summarized parse of d20pfsrd.com's own HTML
# table and the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror, both byte-for-byte
# identical) — bloodline-specific, left named-but-unproven by the
# pre-existing Arcane Bond / bloodline progression blocker, exactly
# mirroring levels 3/5/7/9/11/13/15/17/19 — so no new pillar record is
# grounded from it. No genuinely new spell-level column opens at level 20 on
# either the spells-per-day or spells-known table (the 9th-level column
# already opened at level 18); this fixture exercises only the
# already-widened base-spells-per-day (9 elements) and spells-known (10
# elements) arrays' VALUES rising within their existing shape.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-sorcerer-level20-sd18-widening
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:sorcerer:20
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:17
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline:bloodline:arcane
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline_class_skill:knowledge:arcana
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
